name: Stargate Finance
rootCause: A Discord Mod on LayerZero has reported that a scammer who introduced a phishing link within a proposal vote on the Stargate Snapshot platform, enticing users to stake $STG tokens. Over 1K users took part in the vote, resulting in a loss of ~$43K

descriptions.text: A Discord Mod on LayerZero has reported that a scammer who introduced a phishing link within a proposal vote on the Stargate Snapshot platform, enticing users to stake $STG tokens. Over 1K users took part in the vote, resulting in a loss of ~$43K

Stargate Finance suffered a multi-chain phishing attack on December 4, 2023. A scammer used a fake Snapshot governance proposal to trick over 1,000 users into connecting wallets and authorizing malicious transactions, resulting in losses exceeding $43,000 across Ethereum, Arbitrum, Optimism, and BNB Chain. A scammer staked 50,000 STG tokens to create a bogus governance proposal on the Stargate Snapshot platform. The proposal promised an airdrop for a gSTG token, embedding a phishing link that redirected users to a malicious site. Users who interacted with the site unknowingly granted access, allowing the attacker to steal their assets.
